intro.text: A member of the King's Guard.

items.text: During the highstorm when the Assassin in White attacked, Ralinor stood guard with six bridgemen outside the king's conference chamber. He and Moash formed the rear guard as Kaladin tried to get everyone out of the palace; when the assassin appeared, Ralinor fled with the other guards and Renarin to protect Elhokar and Navani.
